allow_large: The owner asked on 2026-09-30 to move reviews to gpt-6.1-sol; the change is a model-name swap in the review defaults and the tests that pin the old name (41 lines)
done_when: Forge's review default for new repos, the light prototype review (effort stays medium), the client sign-off review's pinned model (effort stays high) and this repo's forge.toml [models.review] all use gpt-6.1-sol, and docs/guide.md names the current defaults (it still says design uses gpt-6-sol). Existing client repos' forge.toml files are not rewritten. Tests that pin the old model name are updated to the new contract.

findings.body: The branch changes the generated review setting and the model required for client sign-off, but changes neither `src/forge/templates/skill.md` nor `src/forge/templates/brief.md`. The supplied repository review rule, also present at `AGENTS.md:53–55`, explicitly requires one of those templates to be updated when a setting changes. Updating `docs/guide.md` alone does not satisfy that requirement. Document the new review defaults and sign-off pin in the coordinator template in this change.
findings.title: Update an agent-facing template for the changed review settings

why: The owner chose gpt-6.1-sol at high effort for reviews too, so every Forge default now uses it, but the review default, the light review, the sign-off pin and Forge's own forge.toml still name gpt-6-sol
